meta.title: Older notifications (before this change) still open the PR list

args.goal: Open the buyer portal notifications from the top-right bell, click the existing old notification stating that assigned PR line items were assigned to User A, and stop on the Purchase Requisitions list showing its list screen.

steps.note: Performs the notification interaction and verifies the resulting PR list in the current buyer session.
Confirms the PR list opened without a visible application error or crash.
